s01.deck: Why add a defense when you can chug a malt beverage instead?
s01.draft:
"Stay thirsty my friends" - Ian Hoby.

Following an Iceless week across the league, our proud league Commissioner vowed not to witness another dry week, picking up the Panthers defense for absolutely no reason. "Dragging teammates into the fight" is a term used across the hockey world, and dragging league mates into chugging Smirnoff Ices is a proud showing of leadership that only Blood Sweat and Mini Beers can provide.
s01.image: Ian licking his lips and rubbing his hands at a frosty Smirnoff Ice

s01.title: After A Week Of No Ices, Commissioner Voluntarily Ices Himself
